name: RenderNet
aliases: RenderNet — A differentiable rendering convolutional neural network that renders 2D images from 3D voxel grids by jointly learning visibility computation and pixel color calculation (shading)
definition: A differentiable rendering convolutional neural network that renders 2D images from 3D voxel grids by jointly learning visibility computation and pixel color calculation (shading).
summary: RenderNet is a differentiable rendering CNN that generates 2D images from 3D voxel grids using a dedicated Projection Unit to learn visibility and shading, enabling robust inverse rendering tasks.
